directions: forward citations discoverable from primary or publisher pages
citation_expansion.include_only_if: The title, abstract, or cited passage asserts an exact full-three-body orbit, an H=C=0 result, or a variational analysis on the double-zero level.

candidate_deduplication: Merge papers that analyze the same phase curve and mass branch into one candidate-family record while retaining every source.
plausibility_rule: Create a candidate record whenever a primary source claims an exact full-three-body solution that could satisfy H=C=0, or explicitly analyzes the double-zero common level. Exclude clearly different physical models at source screening but retain the exclusion receipt.
completion_rule: All Q01-Q12 queries, all eight mandatory candidate classes, all seed sources, every plausible result inside the locked windows, and eligible citation expansion must have receipts before a null decision.
